dataProviders.reason: No live Google service-account / spreadsheet / Drive / admin-auth secrets were present in this environment at any point during implementation. Every domain has a real Google-backed repository implementation (GoogleRentalSource, GoogleRentalOverlayRepository, GoogleProjectRepository, GoogleNewsRepository, GoogleMediaRepository, GoogleDriveBlobStore, GoogleContactRepository) that a config-based factory (isGoogleRuntimeConfigured/isMediaConfigured) will switch to automatically the moment real secrets are set — no code change required.
dataProviders.fixtureSeeding: lib/data/{properties,properties.admin,projects,news,media}.ts — explicitly documented in each providers.ts as design/demo content for local/dev/test only, never treated as production truth.

rentalNormalizationStatus.detail: lib/server/rental/parse.ts handles group-separator rows, column-shift repair, price/area/availability/propertyType parsing, and explicit-phrase-only bedroom/furnishing extraction (never inferred). 40 parser unit tests cover valid/ignored/quarantined outcomes. Never verified against the real 1,102-row production sheet — that requires live Sheets read access.

rentalOverlayStatus.detail: WEB_BDS_OVERRIDES (patch/hide by sourceId) + WEB_BDS_CUSTOM (admin-authored records) merge pipeline in lib/server/rental/merge.ts implements the contract's exact mergeOrder. Real Admin BDS CRUD (create/edit/hide/delete, draft vs. publish) verified end-to-end in a live browser against the in-memory provider, including a create→edit→reload persistence check and a public-listing appearance check. One real bug (id-scheme mismatch causing an orphaned duplicate on edit) was found via live testing and fixed; a regression test guards it.

projectCmsStatus.detail: WEB_PROJECTS real CRUD (lib/server/projects/*, app/actions/projects.ts), Admin list/new/edit pages, public /du-an + /du-an/[slug] wired to live data. The id-scheme lesson from rental was applied proactively — no analogous bug found.

newsCmsStatus.detail: WEB_NEWS real CRUD (lib/server/news/*, app/actions/news.ts), Admin list/new/edit pages, public /tin-tuc + /tin-tuc/[slug] and the homepage news preview wired to live data. Draft/publish state is derived from the existing 'Trạng thái' text field (no new UI control invented) — verified live that a new draft article does not appear publicly until its status is set to 'Đã xuất bản'.

mediaStatus.detail: WEB_MEDIA catalog repository + a separate blob-store abstraction (Google Drive vs. in-memory), MIME/size validation, real upload/delete Server Actions, and a public delivery proxy (/api/media/[id]) that never exposes the service-account credential. Legacy raw-sheet Drive/Photos hyperlink resolution (lib/server/media/legacyResolve.ts) falls back to a placeholder + diagnostic for Photos links, unrecognized formats, and Drive access failures — never fails the whole listing — served via a second proxy (/api/drive-media/[fileId]) for links never uploaded through Admin. A real cross-bundle singleton-splitting bug (uploads via the Server Action were invisible to the separately-bundled Route Handler, causing 404s) was found via live e2e testing and fixed by anchoring the in-memory singleton on globalThis.
mediaStatus.knownLimitation: Legacy media resolution has per-process memoization but no batch pre-resolve or persistent cache — acceptable for review against a 12-item fixture set, but the real ~1,102-row sheet would need that before production traffic once Google credentials are live.

contactStatus.detail: ContactForm UI unchanged; submits through a real Server Action into WEB_CONTACTS. Server-side validation is authoritative (required name/phone, length limits, lenient Vietnamese phone normalization). Off-screen honeypot added without altering the approved layout (pixel-identical to baseline). Client IP is never stored raw — only an HMAC-SHA256 hash (RATE_LIMIT_SECRET, falling back to AUTH_SECRET) — with a two-layer rate limit (in-process + persisted-record check) conservatively capped at 3 submissions per hashed IP per 10 minutes. No Admin Leads/Viewing UI added, per contract.

authStatus.detail: Real single-admin session auth replacing the GĐ4 localStorage mock: scrypt password hashing, HMAC-signed session cookie, proxy.ts doing optimistic presence-only redirects, real re-verification at the DAL (lib/server/auth/dal.ts) on every protected request. Verified live: unauthenticated redirect, wrong password, correct login surviving a hard reload, HttpOnly+SameSite cookie flags, logout, a deliberately tampered cookie being rejected server-side, and remember-me expiry — all 7 cases are permanent Playwright specs in tests/e2e/admin-auth.spec.ts. Two real bugs (a redirect loop with a tampered cookie; a secure-cookie flag breaking local HTTP testing) were found via live testing and fixed.

securityStatus.detail: tests/unit/server/dataLeak.test.ts (15 tests) covers: every admin mutation/list action rejects unauthenticated callers; public DTOs for rental/projects/news never leak commission/guidePerson/internalNotes/id/published/createdAt (checked structurally and via serialized-string search); an unpublished/hidden record's slug is structurally unreachable through the public list→find path; login and Google-config error messages never echo the password/hash/AUTH_SECRET/private key; the raw rental source class exposes exactly one method (listRawRows, no write path at all); contact input enforces its length limits. Media MIME/size validation, rental parser quarantine behavior, and per-action auth spot-checks are covered in their own task's test files. A green suite is one input, not proof of security on its own — no external/adversarial security review has been performed.
